Title: [JOURNEY] OTP sign-in — request code, read it from the email, enter it, land signed in
Preconditions:
[PRE:CLEAR_SESSION]
Store setting OtpSignIn.Enabled is on for {{STORE_ID}} (Admin: Stores > store > Settings > OTP Sign-In > General)
The storefront ingress routes /api/otp to the platform (a 405 on Continue is the defect this journey exists to catch, not a reason to skip)
{{USER_EMAIL}} is a contact of {{STORE_ID}} with lockout enabled and a non-expired password; admin credentials resolve
Steps: --- SCREEN: Sign in - request a code --- [NAV] Navigate to {{FRONT_URL}}/sign-in [ACT] Fill 'Email': {{USER_EMAIL}} [CAPTURE] T0 = current UTC time, taken immediately before the click [ACT] Click 'Continue' [WAIT] the 'Check your email' step is shown --- SCREEN: Check your email --- [ASSERT] The step shows the masked address (not the full {{USER_EMAIL}}), six empty code cells, 'Resend code' and 'Use a different email' --- SCREEN: Notification journal (admin API) --- [AUTH] POST {{BACK_URL}}/connect/token (grant_type=password, username={{ADMIN_EMAIL}}, password={{ADMIN_PASSWORD}}) to obtain an admin Bearer token [HTTP] POST {{BACK_URL}}/api/notifications/journal with the admin Bearer token and JSON body {"keyword":"{{USER_EMAIL}}","take":5,"sort":"createdDate:desc"} [WAIT] poll that call up to 90s until an OtpSignInEmailNotification message to {{USER_EMAIL}} created after T0 appears (SMTP may be off - the message is journaled either way) [CAPTURE] code = the 6-digit value inside ... in that message body --- SCREEN: Check your email --- [ACT] Type the 6 digits of code into 'Code' [WAIT] the page leaves /sign-in (sign-in auto-submits on the 6th digit) --- SCREEN: Signed in --- [ASSERT] The account menu shows the signed-in customer of {{USER_EMAIL}} and /sign-in is no longer the current page [ACT] Reload the page [ASSERT] The account menu still shows the same signed-in customer (the session is real, not a one-render state)
Cross_Layer_Checks:
[API] POST /api/otp/request -> 200 succeeded=true; POST /connect/token grant_type=otp_email -> 200 with access_token
[EMAIL] the OtpSignInEmailNotification message appears in the notification journal within 60s
[ADMIN] Security > Sign-in log has a Type OTP row for the account with succeeded=true
[CONSOLE] no TypeError or JS error on the page under test
[NETWORK] no 4xx/5xx on /graphql or on /api/otp/request
Failure_Signals: 405 on POST /api/otp/request or 'Something went wrong' after Continue (mid-journey: ingress route missing); the 6th digit is typed and the page stays on /sign-in; the account menu is anonymous after the code step; spinner >5s
Cleanup: Sign out through the account menu so the next case starts anonymous

[PRE:CLEAR_SESSION]
OtpSignIn.Enabled is on for {{STORE_ID}}; {{USER_EMAIL}} is a contact of {{STORE_ID}} with lockout enabled
Steps:
[NAV] Navigate to {{FRONT_URL}}/sign-in
[ACT] Fill 'Email': {{USER_EMAIL}}
[CAPTURE] T0 = current UTC time, taken immediately before the click
[ACT] Click 'Continue'
[WAIT] the 'Check your email' step is shown
[ACT] Slow POST /api/otp/request to about 5 seconds (Playwright page.route delay)
[ACT] Click 'Resend code' five times in quick succession
[WAIT] all pending requests settle
[ASSERT] Count POST /api/otp/request calls and read the status text and the error area
[ACT] Remove the delay
Cross_Layer_Checks:
[CONSOLE] no TypeError or JS error on the page under test
[NETWORK] no 4xx/5xx on /api/otp/request or /connect/token other than the one asserted
Failure_Signals: Requests keep firing after the clicks stop; the status text duplicates; the step ends in a spinner
Cleanup:
Remove the request delay
Sign out through the account menu so the next case starts anonymous

Title: /sign-in OTP verify step — an unbreakable value (32-char code, GUID, URL) in a cell
Preconditions:
[PRE:CLEAR_SESSION]
OtpSignIn.Enabled is on for {{STORE_ID}}; {{USER_EMAIL}} is a contact of {{STORE_ID}} with lockout enabled
Steps: [NAV] Navigate to {{FRONT_URL}}/sign-in [ACT] Fill 'Email': email_255 [ACT] Click 'Continue' [WAIT] the page settles (spinner gone, network idle) [ASSERT] Read whether the field text, the validation message or the error banner overflows its box, clips behind a neighbour or widens the page (document scroll width vs viewport width) [ACT] Fill 'Email': email_254 [ACT] Click 'Continue' [WAIT] the page settles (spinner gone, network idle) [ASSERT] Same layout check on whatever the form shows [NAV] Navigate to {{FRONT_URL}}/sign-in [ACT] Fill 'Email': {{USER_EMAIL}} [CAPTURE] T0 = current UTC time, taken immediately before the click [ACT] Click 'Continue' [WAIT] the 'Check your email' step is shown [AUTH] POST {{BACK_URL}}/connect/token (grant_type=password, username={{ADMIN_EMAIL}}, password={{ADMIN_PASSWORD}}) to obtain an admin Bearer token [HTTP] POST {{BACK_URL}}/api/notifications/journal with the admin Bearer token and JSON body {"keyword":"{{USER_EMAIL}}","take":5,"sort":"createdDate:desc"} [WAIT] poll that call up to 90s until an OtpSignInEmailNotification message to {{USER_EMAIL}} created after T0 appears (SMTP may be off - the message is journaled either way) [CAPTURE] code = the 6-digit value inside ... in that message body [ACT] Paste a 32-character alphanumeric string into 'Code' [ACT] Paste a GUID into 'Code' [ACT] Paste the sign-in page URL into 'Code' [ASSERT] Read the code cells and the page width after each paste [ACT] Type the real code [WAIT] the page leaves /sign-in
Cross_Layer_Checks:
[CONSOLE] no TypeError or JS error on the page under test
[NETWORK] no 4xx/5xx on /api/otp/request or /connect/token other than the one asserted
Failure_Signals: Text painted outside the input; page widens with a horizontal scrollbar; a GUID or URL accepted into the cells; cells broken after the paste
Cleanup: Sign out through the account menu so the next case starts anonymous
